title: Framework Math Family Crate Consolidation
description:
This is part of W8b ("Framework wave", family batch) in the approved plan `/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-codebase-still-has-spicy-umbrella.md` — read it in full first, especially "Key merges" → "Math", "Final counts", "Deletions/hygiene" (25 math stubs), and "Architecture risks"/"Top risks" entries mentioning math/stub deletion.

CONTEXT — read in full, in this order:
1. The spicy-umbrella plan file above.
2. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md` — the master tracking doc, read in FULL. It documents ~40+ hard-won lessons across the whole initiative (leftover-verification-overlay bugs — CRITICAL, this class of bug has broken `cargo metadata` repo-wide at least 4 separate times, always clean up your own overlay + nested target/Cargo.lock before handoff; the systemic `Ok(`-corruption pattern; `#[path]` cumulative-resolution semantics — two valid conventions coexist, read the relevant notes carefully; DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools workaround; the registrar protocol). Also read the very recent notes about M1-M9 (the mechanism wave that JUST landed) — `🔣️taxonomy.json`+`🟦️discovery.ts` are your new source of truth for taxonomy shape, and the registry/root-policy scripts now discover framework packages via `role = "framework"` in `[package.metadata.semio]`.
3. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md` — the per-plugin migration recipe (Shape V2 shape conventions apply identically to framework families — read it for the mechanical playbook, adapting "plugin" to "framework family" throughout).
4. `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️lib/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/🔣️taxonomy.json` and `🟦️discovery.ts` — the shared vocabulary/discovery library, read in full.
5. `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🧮️math/` — read the CURRENT directory structure in full (all ~52 impl dirs) before making any decisions. Identify the 25 stub crates the plan mentions (should be exactly 25 lines each) — confirm this by actually reading a few, don't assume.

YOUR TASK: consolidate ALL of `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🧮️math/`'s ~52 implementation directories into ONE crate `semio-framework-math` (+ its npm sibling `@semio-tech/framework-math`) at `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🧮️math/📦️packages/{🦀️rust,🟦️typescript}/`, following the SAME Shape V2 taxonomy conventions used for every plugin migration (domain-tree component files, `📦️lib.rs` inside `📦️packages/🦀️rust/`, `[package.metadata.semio] role = "framework"`). This is bigger and more architecturally varied than any single plugin (graph family alone has 33 impl dirs, includes graph-manifest's build.rs + fixtures which must move with it) — take the time to actually read and understand the domain structure before restructuring, don't just mechanically flatten.

**Critical, explicit instruction from the plan**: delete the 25 stub crates (and their npm mirrors) OUTRIGHT — do not migrate them. Before deleting each one, grep the WHOLE repo for its crate name / package name in sibling `[dependencies]`/`use` lines to confirm zero real consumers (the plan warns "stub deletion needs a dependents grep" as a real architecture risk — do not skip this check for even one stub).

Framework crates have a MUCH larger dependent footprint than any plugin (math family alone may have several real consumers across framework + plugins — check `cargo tree` / grep for `mathematical_graph`-style deps before assuming isolation). Apply the same rigor as a plugin migration: preserve `[package.metadata.*]` verbatim from surviving (non-stub) crates, wire-format-diff proof where a wire codec exists, full test suite ported with baseline comparison, cross-cutting dependent search covering BOTH Cargo.toml path strings AND `use`-line imports (a repeatedly-confirmed gap class in this initiative — grep both).

VERIFICATION: `cargo check` (native + `--target wasm32-wasip2` — math crates likely need to be wasm-safe since they're consumed by the os-kernel), `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools cargo test --lib` with full baseline comparison, `bun` equivalent for the TS side if `@semio-tech/framework-math` has real content. Run the registry's taxonomy check (`bun 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/📇️registry/📜️script.ts check`) to confirm your new crate is discovered correctly as `role = "framework"`.

CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable, this is exclusive ownership of `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🧮️math/**` only):
- Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, root package.json workspaces, nx.json, .storybook, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, the registry script/generated output, .vscode/launch.json, any plugin directory, or any OTHER framework family's directory (ui, compiler, surface, hash/editor/schema, assets, os/kernel/host — those are separate tickets/agents working in parallel right now; touch only math).
- Never run git-modifying commands or use git worktrees.
- Do NOT use `run_in_background: true` for Bash — run synchronously with generous timeouts (600s+, this is a large family).
- Delete this whole overlay block along with any nested target/Cargo.lock BEFORE you close your ticket — this exact class of leftover has broken root `cargo metadata` for the whole repo multiple times already this initiative, per the master doc's own lessons.
- Add temporary files to your own ticket folder.
- When finished, call `mcp__repo__ticket_close` on your own ticket's exact path with a full summary (architecture decisions, what was deleted and why, dependent-search results, verification results) and file list. End with a registrar-handoff block (exact root Cargo.toml member lines to remove/add, workspace.dependencies aliases to remove) since you must never touch root Cargo.toml yourself. Do not touch any other ticket.

Report back a concise summary of your architecture decisions, what you deleted, and your verification results.
